_doc: Obfuscator variant registry for static builds. family = pass-style family (mllvm/xllvm/ollvm). kind = fork (in-tree LLVM fork, source-buildable) | plugin (out-of-tree pass, needs matching LLVM dev sysroot) | prebuilt (shipped binaries, register only). Version-to-version basis: each variant parallels the regular build of its base. NOT listed: obpo-plugin (IDA/Hex-Rays cloud plugin, not clang), movfuscator (lcc-based, not clang), cpullvm-toolchain (Qualcomm LLVM fork toolchain, not an obfuscator).

chain_front.name: Khaos-master
chain_front.note: NOT a build target (LLVM 9, outside 12-22). Khaos -O0 emit feeds the clang-12 ob tools, so the 12-set must keep IR and -mllvm pass compatibility with Khaos output.

Obfvious.note: Integral part of clang (invoked via clang.exe); upstream builds on Windows, linux build unverified, may need porting. In-tree: integral part of clang (llvm/ + clang/ in repo).

ObfuscatorNDK.note: Prebuilt NDK23/Windows package (clang 12.0.9, -mllvm -fla -bcf -sub -sobf), not a source build. Register only.

Buer-Obfuscator.note: Out-of-tree: builds libObfuscator.so, loaded via -fpass-plugin. Needs LLVM 14 dev sysroot.

obfuscator-llvm.note: Out-of-tree pass plugin; builds against llvmorg-14.0.6, needs matching LLVM dev sysroot. eshard NPM plugin; -fpass-plugin / -load-pass-plugin UX.

HimitsuObfuscator.note: Lightweight, stable, gpl-free llvm-17 obfuscator for linux. Flag-driven: -mllvm -sobf on its in-tree clang build.

Kotoamatsukami.note: LLVM-17 new pass manager style. Out-of-tree NPM project (own driver + passes, no llvm/ in repo). Needs LLVM 17 dev sysroot.

o-mvll.note: Python-driven, loaded via -fpass-plugin; built against NDK r26d LLVM. Needs matching LLVM dev sysroot.

ollvm.note: Legacy in-tree fork (branch ollvm-22.x), direct llvm-project lineage via und3ath/ollvm. NOT Hikari/Pluto derived. Superseded by xollvm; kept for reference builds.

xollvm.note: Successor to ollvm: annotation-driven, new pass manager, zero LLVM source edits. Plugs into stock LLVM 22 (also 23) via LLVM_EXTERNAL_PROJECTS or -fpass-plugin. Needs matching LLVM dev sysroot.

Hikari-fix-LLVM22.note: Out-of-tree pass plugin (loads into clang/opt); needs an LLVM 22 dev sysroot, not a standalone fork build.

kagura.note: NPM toolkit (flattening, string encryption, VM virtualization, anti-tamper), -fpass-plugin, no LLVM tree edits. One codebase spans LLVM 17-22; needs per-version LLVM dev sysroot per build.

Obscura.note: Hikari/O-MVLL successor generation (C/C++/ObjC/Swift), -fpass-plugin. Per-base status: 13 Generally Stable, 16 Untested, 17 Stable, 19.1.5 Stable.

Hallucina.note: In-tree generated clang (LLVM 17), flag-driven -mllvm -irobf family (indbr/icall/indgv/cff). Niche purpose: confuse LLM clients via MCP disassembler servers.
